name: anchoran-os
description: Anchoran OS - an immersive desktop environment shell for Windows.
author: Anchoran

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && cross-env ANCHORAN_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.build:kioskhook: dotnet publish native/kioskhook -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true
scripts.build: npm run sync-version && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:kioskhook && electron-builder
scripts.dist:setup: cd installer && npm install && npm run dist
scripts.dist:full: npm run dist && npm run prepare-installer-source && npm run dist:setup
